front.title: Terminology for the Discovery of Agents With Names (DAWN)

abstract.t:
The proliferation of distributed Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and agents has created a need for interoperable mechanisms for components of AI systems to discover each other.
This document defines terminology for Discovery of Agents With Names (DAWN), focusing on the terms necessary to describe the discovery of information about AI systems and resources (e.g., AI agents). The intention is that this common set of terms can be used by other documents related to DAWN and so achieve consistency of meaning across the space.
